items.title: Computer Vision – ECCV 2026
items.description:
The multi-volume set of LNCS books with volume numbers 17001 up to 17078 constitutes the refereed proceedings of the 19th European Conference on Computer Vision, ECCV 2026, held in Malmö, Sweden, during September 8–12, 2026. 

The 2834 papers presented in these proceedings were carefully reviewed and selected from a total of 10,473 submissions. They deal with topics such as computer vision; machine learning; deep neural networks; reinforcement learning; object recognition; image classification; image processing; object detection; semantic segmentation; human pose estimation; 3D reconstruction; stereo vision; computational photography; neural networks; image coding; image reconstruction; and motion estimation.

items.title: Artificial Intelligence – COMIA 2026
items.description:
The 3-volume set CCIS 3095 - 3097 constitutes the proceedings of the 18th Mexican Congress on Artificial Intelligence, COMIA 2026, which took place in Cuernavaca, Mexico, during May 25 - 29, 2026. 

The total of 183 papers included in the proceedings was carefully reviewed and selected from 312 submissions. They were organized in topical sections as follows: 

Part 1 : Applications of Artificial Intelligence; Medical Applications. Part 2 : Machine learning and pattern recognition; Artificial Vision and Robotics; Computational Intelligence and Data Mining. Part 3 : Natural language processing; Intelligent systems; Deep learning.

items.title: Artificial Neural Networks and Machine Learning – ICANN 2026
items.description: The five-volume set LNCS 17089-17093 constitutes the proceedings of the 35th International Conference on Artificial Neural Networks and Machine Learning, ICANN 2026, held in Padua, Italy on September 14–17, 2026. The 296 papers included in these conference proceedings were carefully reviewed and selected from 450 submissions. The conference strongly values the synergy between theoretical progress and impactful real-world applications, and actively encourages contributions that demonstrate how artificial neural networks are being used to address pressing societal and technological challenges.

items.title: Persuasive Technology. PERSUASIVE 2026 Satellite Events
items.description:
This book constitutes the proceedings of the PERSUASIVE 2026 Satellite Events, held together with the 21th International Conference on Persuasive Technology, in Hakodate , Japan, during March 10–13, 2026 . 
 The 37 full papers and 20 short papers were included in this book were carefully reviewed and selected from 69 submissions. This conference on the proceedings of the satellite events of the conference, including the accepted papers in the Late Breaking Results track, Posters, Demonstrations and Artefacts, Workshops and Doctoral Consortium papers.
